mapper.select: SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM company c LEFT JOIN division d ON c.company_code = d.company_code WHERE c.company_code = #{company_code} ORDER BY c.company_code, d.division_code
SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM company c WHERE c.company_code = #{p_company_code}

SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM division d WHERE d.company_code = #{p_company_code} and d.division_code = #{p_division_code} ORDER BY c.company_code, d.division_code
